issues.text: No LinkedIn or portfolio link — recruiters expect at least one.
Only 4/18 bullets show measurable impact. Add metrics (%, $, time, scale).
Drop first-person pronouns (i) — résumés use implied first person ("Built…", not "I built…").
Replace cliché buzzwords with evidence: cutting-edge, seamless.
Missing 17 key skills from the job description: vue.js, machine learning, google cloud, ci/cd, javascript, solid, nestjs, postgresql….

passed: Bullets lead with strong action verbs

topFixes: Add 'JavaScript' to the Frontend skills list to explicitly match the job requirement.
Include 'Git' under a new Version Control skill category (or alongside existing Cloud & Infra) to satisfy the version‑control keyword.
Highlight CI/CD experience: note that you automated deployments to GCP Cloud Run using GitHub Actions or Cloud Build, and list 'CI/CD pipelines' under Cloud & Infra.
Emphasize Machine Learning/AI by adding a bullet in the Tradyon internship or summary that mentions 'LLM‑powered AI chatbot development and agentic workflows' to capture the machine‑learning keyword.
Show Agile/Scrum exposure: add a phrase like 'Worked in Agile/Scrum sprints with daily stand‑ups and sprint planning' to the Tradyon experience bullets.
llm.verdict: The resume already covers many core full‑stack skills; surfacing JavaScript, Git, CI/CD, ML/AI, and Agile/Scrum terms will align it closely with Axonex’s job description without inventing experience.
